comparison.objective: Hand-tighten a spin-on oil filter to the specified angle past gasket contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread following, bimanual regrasping, wrist-driven rotation, and turn-count/torque-proxy regulation.
comparison.success_condition: Filter ends 240–360 degrees past contact without removal or over-tightening, most rotation credited to a holding wrist, hand released, and full state held one second.
comparison.reason: This tests controlled threaded rotation and regrasping. It does not fracture or remove a component, withstand hammer impulse, protect insert pose, or recover debris.
